judge.reason: The memo centers on the review and integration bottleneck, scope cuts, WIP caps, and the critical path. It declines to fabricate a P85 and rejects the eight extra agents with a Brooks/bottleneck rationale, reconsidering them only if measured conditions change. It also rejects halving regression checks in favor of making them faster or more targeted, and it does not invoke a one-third-timeline cutoff, which meets the rubric.
